decisions.name: go-api-contracts
decisions.reason: Selected: exported Run behavior and error contract change; preserve the exact function signature, error identity, supported module version, and standard-library dependencies.

decisions.name: go-behavior-tests
decisions.reason: Selected: periodic recurrence and host cleanup behavior change, with explicit request for high-quality lifecycle tests. Read the behavior-observations reference to choose independent error cases and host-boundary assertions.

decisions.name: go-core-style
decisions.reason: Selected: implementation and tests are Go code; use explicit errors, small functions, standard-library contexts and timers, owned goroutine lifetime, and gofmt.

decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
decisions.reason: Selected: Run now owns a periodic worker and its child context; completion, cancellation, joining, and resource release need explicit ordering. Existing function dependencies suffice without new interfaces.

decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
decisions.reason: Not selected: the existing sweeper package already owns the host and worker. No new package, import direction, relocation, or distinct responsibility is introduced.
